consent.text: Ask Hava: Got it. Next, a few quick questions. Ask Hava is not a contractor; you hire the business you pick directly. Automated texts about your request. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Terms: askhava.com/terms Privacy: askhava.com/privacy

consent_safety_call.text: Ask Hava: Got it. Next, a few quick questions. Ask Hava is not a contractor; you hire the business you pick directly. Automated texts about your request. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. If you report a danger like gas or smoke and we can't text, we may try one recorded call to this number. Don't wait for it: call 911. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Terms: askhava.com/terms Privacy: askhava.com/privacy

who_is_this.text: Ask Hava: Ask Hava is a local service. Our texts are automated. The Ask Hava owner gets HELP messages right away and usually replies within 2 days, or within 24 hours if your job is urgent.

opt_out_confirmation.text: Ask Hava: You're unsubscribed. You won't get more texts or automated calls from Ask Hava at this number. To use Ask Hava again, text START.

start_reply.text: Ask Hava: You can text us again. Send your request to start. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to opt out.

help_reply.text: Ask Hava: Tell us what's wrong in one text. The Ask Hava owner gets HELP messages right away and usually replies within {reply_time}. This number is text-only. If anyone is in danger, call 911. Can't open links? Reply LIST to get your quotes by text. Help: help@askhava.com or askhava.com/help Reply STOP to opt out.

help_reply_ca.text: Ask Hava: Tell us what's wrong in one text. The Ask Hava owner gets HELP messages right away and usually replies within {reply_time}. This number is text-only. If anyone is in danger, call 911. Can't open links? Reply LIST to get your quotes by text. Canadian numbers may pay roaming charges. Help: help@askhava.com or askhava.com/help Reply STOP to opt out.

help_reply_away.text: Ask Hava: Tell us what's wrong in one text. The Ask Hava owner is away until {time} and will reply by then. If anyone is in danger, call 911. Can't open links? Reply LIST to get your quotes by text. Help: help@askhava.com or askhava.com/help Reply STOP to opt out.

Reply LIST to get your quotes by text. Canadian numbers may pay roaming charges. Help: help@askhava.com or askhava.com/help Reply STOP to opt out.

emergency_911.text: Ask Hava: Ask Hava isn't an emergency service. If you smell gas, see smoke or fire, a CO alarm is going off, or a power line is down, get everyone out and call 911 from outside. Reply SAFE when you're safe.

spanish_not_yet.text: Ask Hava: For now we text in English. Reply HELP if you need help.

under_18.text: Ask Hava: Sorry, you must be 18 or older to use Ask Hava. Please ask a parent or adult to text us.

request_out.text: Ask Hava: Request {job} is out to {count} {trade} businesses. Not every business answers. We'll text you when the first quote comes in.

first_quote.text: Ask Hava: Your first quote for request {job} is in, and more may come. Free for you. The business you pick pays Ask Hava a set introduction fee. Can't open links? Reply LIST to get your quotes by text. See them here: {link} Terms (18+): askhava.com/terms

all_quotes_in.text: Ask Hava: All quotes are in for request {job}: {quoted} of {count} businesses quoted. {link} Reply LIST to see them here, or CLOSE {job} if you don't need it.

no_quotes_yet.text: Ask Hava: No quotes yet for request {job}. A few more details or a photo often help a business price it. Reply 1 to add details, 2 to keep waiting, or 3 to close.

closed_no_quotes.text: Ask Hava: Request {job} is closed because no quotes came in. Text us any time to try again.

closed_no_pick.text: Ask Hava: Request {job} is closed because no quote was picked. Text us any time to start a new one.

closed_no_quote_left.text: Ask Hava: Request {job} is closed because none of its quotes can go ahead. Text us any time to start a new one.

caller_missed.text: Ask Hava: {business} tried to call you about request {job}. Call them back on {number}.

problem_reply.text: Ask Hava: Thanks. The Ask Hava owner reads every problem report, usually within 7 days. Ask Hava can't settle disputes about work or price. Licensed trades: you can also file with the state at askhava.com/help/roc-complaint.

close_howto.text: Ask Hava: Reply CLOSE {job} to close request {job}. If that doesn't fix it, reply with what's wrong and the Ask Hava owner gets it right away.

cost_answer.text: Ask Hava: It's free for you. The business you pick pays Ask Hava a fixed introduction fee ($25, $75 or $199, by quote size). You pay the business directly for the work. If that doesn't fix it, reply with what's wrong and the Ask Hava owner gets it right away.

business_no_call_reminder.text: Ask Hava: Job {job}: no call yet. Call within 72 hours of the release, or the fee can't be refunded. Call between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. Arizona time (any hour on an emergency job). Your 2 attempts can be on different days.

business_pick_waiting.text: Ask Hava: A homeowner picked your quote for job {job}. Accept by {time}.

beep_question.text: Ask Hava: Is it 1) a chirp every minute or so, or 2) an alarm that keeps going off?

how_soon.text: Ask Hava: How soon do you need this? 1) Today, it's urgent 2) In the next few days 3) No rush 4) By a certain day

needed_by_day.text: Ask Hava: Which day do you need it by?

emergency_choice.text: Ask Hava: Is this an emergency? Emergency: businesses get your request by email marked EMERGENCY, and the business you pick has 60 minutes to confirm. Businesses that get emergency requests at night may be able to come tonight. After-hours work usually costs more. Reply 1 for emergency or 2 for regular.

night_count_many.text: Ask Hava: {count} {trade} businesses on Ask Hava get emergency requests at night.

night_count_one.text: Ask Hava: 1 {trade} business on Ask Hava gets emergency requests at night.

night_count_none.text: Ask Hava: No {trade} business on Ask Hava gets emergency requests at night yet. Your request goes out at 8 a.m.
